VPH.moveHint: Drag to move. Arrow keys: move; Shift: larger step.
VPH.resizeHint: Drag to resize. Left/right arrow keys: adjust width.
VPH.empty: No characters. The GM can configure the roster.
VPH.rosterHint: Add actors or tokens to either panel. The roster is shared; layout and theme are personal.
VPH.rosterRemoveHint: Removing hides the character from the HUD even when detected automatically. Add it again to restore it.
VPH.resetHint: Return both panels to their default positions and widths, expand all bars and clear your custom order.
VPH.auto: Automatic: combat, VND and player characters

enabled.name: Show Party HUD
enabled.hint: Enable or disable both panels in this browser.

theme.name: Visual style
theme.hint: Classic, D. Dungeon or the new Velvet Eclipse. Quick actions use the same style.

replaceVnd.name: Replace VND side HUD
replaceVnd.hint: Hide its side panels to avoid duplicates while Party HUD is enabled.

showHpNumbers.name: Show HP numbers to everyone
showHpNumbers.hint: The GM and owners always see their numbers. Enable to also reveal others' HP, including NPCs.

source.name: Roster source
source.hint: Automatic combines the current scene's combat, VND cast and player-owned characters; Manual uses only your selection.

qa.emptyAll: This actor has no usable attacks, spells or items.

notify.qaFailed: The action failed. See the console for details.
notify.qaCantUse: Couldn't use that from here — try the character sheet.

license.title: License and Patreon support
license.hint: Open Velvet License Hub to manage Patreon. The HUD works with or without a subscription.
license.fallback: The HUD remains available. Velvet License Hub is unavailable; install or enable version 2 to manage Patreon and shared reminders.
